social_media.headline: CME Under Analysis
social_media.summary: A significant solar flare occurred from Active Region 3664. Initial imagery suggests a CME may have been produced, and analysis is underway.

confidence.label: Confidence
confidence.detail: An Earth-directed component has not been confirmed, and no calibrated arrival probability is available yet.

what_we_know: A significant flare occurred from Active Region 3664.
Initial imagery indicates a CME may have been produced.
An Earth-directed component is possible but not confirmed.
Imagery and model analysis are underway.

footer.left: SWPC is analyzing the event and will issue updates as confidence changes.
footer.center: No Watch or Warning is in effect for this event.
